# Capital City Heating & Cooling

> > Capital City Heating & Cooling provides comprehensive HVAC repair, installation, and maintenance services for residential and commercial customers across the Boise, Idaho area.

Capital City Heating & Cooling serves the Treasure Valley region including Boise, Meridian, Nampa, Eagle, Caldwell, and surrounding communities with expert heating, cooling, and air quality solutions. The company specializes in furnace repair, AC repair, heat pump installation, and carries leading brands including Amana, Goodman, and Daikin.
